justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/share/{AppPickerActivity.java,AppInfo.java,LoadPackagesAsyncTask.java,BookmarkAdapter.java,BookmarkPickerActivity.java,ShareActivity.java}, android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java, android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/clipboard/ClipboardInterface.java, and android/AndroidManifest.xml. The package’s outgoing project dependencies are limited to com.google.zxing.client.android.{Intents,Contents,R} and com.google.zxing.client.android.clipboard.ClipboardInterface; those are used by multiple app areas, while incoming references to this package were found only from CaptureActivity and the manifest entries for ShareActivity/AppPickerActivity/BookmarkPickerActivity. That gives no evidence of the package depending on a less stable project package than itself.
